On states 205/206 with the flag byte at this+0x40 clear, it conditionally posts operation code 66 to the target object's vtable data (*(*(this)+0x14)) when the counter at this+0x78 is below the limit at this+0x60, calls the state-transition function pointer at *(this+0x17C)+4, and moves to state 210. State 207 also moves to 210. Any other non-210 state posts operation code 18 plus the current state to the target and performs a vtable dispatch. After the state block, a do-while loop polls the processing function pointer at *(this+0x18C)+0; when the completion byte at *(this+0x18C)+0x11 is set it invokes the final-dispatch pointer at *(this+0x14)+0x18 and calls VirtualDispatchConditionalValue before returning 1. Returns 0 when the polled processing function reports no further work.
